text: Rice Patrol 是面向 DSH 网页端的推理循环检测与恢复插件。它监视模型推理文本，在短句重复达到条件后停止生成，并让原会话中的主 Agent 继续未完成任务。恢复状态显示在对话输入区，可手动停止恢复或关闭提醒。检测依据是当前请求中的推理文本，预警后需再次符合条件才会确认。适合处理模型推理卡住的情况，无需外部服务或 API 密钥。

Rice Patrol detects repeated short lines in DSH reasoning, stops a confirmed loop, and resumes the unfinished task with the main agent in the same session. Recovery status and controls appear beside the conversation input. No external service or API key is required.
模型一直重复短句、推理不往下走时，能自动停下来并接着做原任务吗？
让 DSH 检测思考循环，并在当前会话里继续未完成的工作。
我想看到恢复进度，必要时能手动停止自动恢复。
Rice Patrol 的功能「重复推理检测」：监视模型推理文本，按最近窗口中的短行长度和重复比例判断循环；先发出预警，后续窗口再次符合条件才确认并停止生成。
Rice Patrol 的功能「原会话任务接续」：循环确认后排除中断的推理内容，向原会话排入继续任务的消息，并在对话输入区展示恢复状态及停止/关闭提醒操作。

dsh-rice-patrol README · Rice Patrol 🍚🐋：[中文](README.zh-CN.md)

Rice Patrol protects reasoning streams in DeepSeek Harness (DSH). When sustained short-line repetition is confirmed, it stops the current generation and resumes the unfinished task in the same conversation.

dsh-rice-patrol README · One automatic recovery flow：Enable the plugin; no response-mode selection is needed. Every confirmed loop follows the same stop-and-resume flow. There is no Stop / Observe / Recover selector, observation logger, or n-gram detector.

Legacy `mode: stop`, `mode: observe`, and `mode: recover` values no longer select behavior. They may be removed, but leaving them in an old profile does not prevent automatic recovery. Use DSH's plugin enable/disable control to turn off Rice Patrol entirely.

dsh-rice-patrol README · One automatic recovery flow：The **Stop recovery** button remains available during recovery. New user input also interrupts the current recovery. Unverifiable session or background-job state pauses recovery with an explanation.

dsh-rice-patrol README · Detection：The plugin reads reasoning text exposed by DSH, splits it into trimmed nonempty lines, and scores the last **50 lines**. A median line length of at most **20 characters**, with at least **70% of lines** having an exact duplicate inside that window, produces a warning. After at least 50 additional nonempty lines, another matching window confirms the loop and stops generation.

dsh-rice-patrol README · Detection：A warning alone does not stop output. The rule is provider-independent and uses a fresh detector for each model request. An ordinary output-token limit is outside its scope. This update does not change detection thresholds.

dsh-rice-patrol README · Continuation：Rice Patrol waits for the stopped generation and stream cleanup, verifies host background jobs, excludes interrupted reasoning from model-visible history, and continues through the original Agent and session. Completed file edits and tool results remain available. The continuation asks the model to inspect workspace state before repeating side effects.

dsh-rice-patrol README · Continuation：Each newly confirmed loop can recover; the same stop submits only one handoff. Failed or blocked old recoveries do not restart themselves. The resumed Agent follows normal DSH policies, without an extra summarization model request or plugin-imposed limits on later model/tool calls.

dsh-rice-patrol README · Continuation：`resumeTimeoutMs` defaults to five minutes for handoff and the first resumed response, rather than the entire subsequent task. Minimal recovery status and deduplication records remain; there is no per-chunk observation log.

dsh-rice-patrol README · Enablement and configuration：The current package is `0.2.11-desktopcompat.1`. It requires DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` or newer (`0.2.1-rc.1` included) and has no upper bound, so later 0.2.x releases load without a version exemption. The source is available on GitHub; this update does not publish an npm package.

dsh-rice-patrol README · Enablement and configuration：DSH checks a plugin's declared requirements at load time and skips any plugin pinned to a different exact version. Rice Patrol now declares `>=0.2.0-rc.2` for `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction`, which is why it stays enabled across 0.2.x patch releases.

Enable Rice Patrol and its components on the Plugins page. The plugin page explains automatic recovery; recovery status appears near the conversation input. See [config/recover.example.yml](config/recover.example.yml).

dsh-rice-patrol README · Enablement and configuration：Provider/model filters, state directory, and recovery timeouts remain configurable. Response mode is not configurable. Use only one controller that cancels and resumes a given reasoning stream.

Restart DSH after updating installed files to load the new host code. Historical implementation notes are in [docs/SINGLE_AGENT_RECOVERY.md](docs/SINGLE_AGENT_RECOVERY.md). MIT license.

dsh-rice-patrol README · Rice Patrol 🍚🐋：[English](README.md)

Rice Patrol 保护 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的推理过程。模型持续重复短句、迟迟不推进任务时，插件确认循环，停止当前生成，然后在原会话恢复未完成的任务。

dsh-rice-patrol README · 固定的自动恢复流程：启用插件后无需选择处理模式。每次确认循环，都会先截断重复推理，再尝试让原来的主 Agent 接续。没有 Stop、Observe 或 Recover 下拉选择，也没有观察日志或 n-gram 检测。

旧配置和旧设置中保存的 `mode: stop`、`mode: observe`、`mode: recover` 均不再决定行为。升级时可以删除这些字段；即使保留也会自动恢复。要关闭整个插件，使用 DSH 自带的插件启停开关。

你仍可在恢复期间点“停止恢复”，也可以发送新的指令中断这次恢复。无法核对会话或后台任务时，插件会暂停并显示原因。

dsh-rice-patrol README · 怎么判断循环？：插件读取 DSH 暴露的推理文本，按换行分成非空行，去掉行首尾空白。最近 **50 行**的长度中位数不超过 **20 个字符**，且至少 **70% 的行**在同一窗口中有完全相同的重复行时，首次预警。再增加至少 50 个非空行，并再次满足条件，才确认并截断。

仅预警不会停止生成。规则不依赖特定服务商或关键词，每个模型请求独立判断。普通输出的 token 上限不属于本插件的检测对象。这一版没有修改检测阈值。

dsh-rice-patrol README · 如何接续？：插件等待当前生成和流清理完成，核对宿主后台任务，将本次中断推理从模型可见历史中排除，再让原 Agent 沿用同一会话继续。已经完成的文件修改和工具结果保留，接续时模型会被提醒先检查工作区状态。

每次新的循环都可以恢复，同一次截断只提交一次交接。恢复失败或受阻的旧任务不会自行再次启动。主 Agent 接续后遵循 DSH 原有执行策略；插件不额外调用模型生成摘要，也不限制接续后任务的请求或工具调用次数。

`resumeTimeoutMs` 默认 5 分钟，用于等待交接和首次接续响应，不是后续任务总时长限制。恢复状态和防止重复交接所需的记录会保留；插件不采集逐块观察日志。

dsh-rice-patrol README · 启用与配置：当前版本为 `0.2.11-desktopcompat.1`。要求 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` 或更高版本（含 `0.2.1-rc.1`），不设上限，因此后续 0.2.x 版本无需再申请版本豁免即可加载。源码同步到 GitHub；本次不发布 npm 包。

DSH 在加载时会检查插件声明的依赖版本，凡把版本钉死在某个具体值上的插件都会被跳过。Rice Patrol 现在为 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` 和 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction` 声明 `>=0.2.0-rc.2`，因此在 0.2.x 的补丁版本之间不会因升级而失效。

在 Plugins 页面启用 Rice Patrol 及其组件即可。插件页面显示自动恢复说明，恢复状态显示在对话输入区附近。配置示例见 [config/recover.example.yml](config/recover.example.yml)。

可以配置服务商/模型过滤、状态目录和恢复等待时限；无需配置处理模式。与其他会取消和恢复同一推理流的插件同时使用时，应只启用一个恢复控制器。
dsh-rice-patrol README · 启用与配置：升级文件写入后需重启 DSH 才会加载新宿主代码。历史实现和验证记录见 [docs/SINGLE_AGENT_RECOVERY.md](docs/SINGLE_AGENT_RECOVERY.md)。项目使用 MIT 许可。
